notes: A walk through the Elixir language in 30 exercises, one per day: hello world, unit testing, IO, lists, maps, records, fibonacci, process rings, ping, sudoku solver, card deck, quine, dining philosophers, GenServer, Supervisor, :inets, sockets, streams, sets, and a small web app (frank, days 26-28). README plus all 30 .exs files. Support files (support/cow.txt, sha1.erl, tree.txt/png, wiki/HomePage) are NOT included; several exercises reference them. Files joined with '--- SOURCE: <repo path> ---' separators, code unmodified.
